Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 03/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 89 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Public Health by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of microblading facilities the Department must license, regulate, and inspect as provided for by this bill. The increase in obligation will be offset, in total or in part, by licensure fees collected by the Department of $250 for an initial license, $200 for renewal of an annual license, and $50 for a temporary license to operate at a fixed location for not more than two weeks.
In addition, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health
